summary: Larimer County, CO site in the Roosevelt National Forest; a 1931 newspaper item calls it a fire lookout, and the FFLA lists it as abandoned.

facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source describes the site now.

events.note: Described as the fire lookout for the Manhattan ranger station in a Fort Collins Express-Courier item of October 7, 1931, quoted on Forest Lookouts

evidence.supports: outing by members of the Mountain Club
evidence.quote: members of the Mountain Club for the Sunday outing

evidence.supports: fire lookout for the Manhattan ranger station
evidence.quote: This mountain is the fire lookout for the Manhattan ranger station

evidence.supports: view from Medicine Bow range to the plains
evidence.quote: from which may be seen everything from the Medicine Bow range to the plains

evidence.supports: item source is the Fort Collins Express-Courier
FFLA lists Larimer County, unknown type, status Abandoned

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as Abandoned, not removed. No source read says the structure was taken down.

notes_for_editor: Two thin sources. The 1931 item is quoted second-hand on the Forest Lookouts page; the original newspaper was not checked. The FFLA gives type Unknown and no NHLR or FFLOS number. No built date, design, staffing or current condition was found. The Colorado Fire Lookout Tower Collection (historycolorado.org Mss.02651 PDF) came up in search but returned no text, so it is unread and may hold more. The brief status gone is corrected to abandoned on the FFLA evidence.
